requirement: F09 forced transcode starts, produces browser-playable HLS, advances media progress, and closes with FFmpeg terminated and stream output removed.

toolingScope.obligation: Observe the existing browser's forced-transcode path, HLS playlist/segment responses, actual media-time advancement, and the stream-scoped FFmpeg process before and after close.
toolingScope.existingRunnerGap: browser-check.cjs exercised direct play only; operational-milestone.cjs fetched HLS over HTTP but did not use Chromium, compare Node against Go, retain HLS response bodies, or observe process liveness/termination.
toolingScope.smallestObservation: Added one forced-transcode variant to existing browser-check.cjs; it uses separate deterministic long multi-file fixtures per implementation and records HLS response status, selected headers, body length/hash, media time, FFmpeg PID visibility, and stream-directory cleanup.
toolingScope.notAdded: No new runner, report framework, generic harness abstraction, or broad normalization. Session IDs are reduced to presence/matching, currentTime is rounded to 100ms only in the paired summary, and every HLS response count/status/type/length/body hash is compared.

red.command: BROWSER_CHECK_OUT=/private/tmp/abs-f09-transcode-red GOCACHE=/private/tmp/abs-f09-gocache mise exec node@22 -- node go-backend/tools/parity/browser-check.cjs --variant transcode --fixture /private/tmp/abs-f08-final-green/fixture-manifest.json
red.result: The HLS media workflow diverged. Go always encoded AAC while pinned Stream.js copied AAC input. Go exposed an empty first segment then a 404 while it was being produced; Chromium reported an HLS demuxer error. Node served readable segments without that error. Both sides had live FFmpeg before close and terminated/removed stream output afterward.

green.command: BROWSER_CHECK_OUT=/private/tmp/abs-f09-transcode-final GOCACHE=/private/tmp/abs-f09-gocache SSRF_REQUEST_FILTER_WHITELIST=127.0.0.1 mise exec node@22 -- node go-backend/tools/parity/browser-check.cjs --variant transcode --fixture /private/tmp/abs-f08-final-green/fixture-manifest.json
green.runtime: Node v22.23.4; Go 1.27.0; actual host FFmpeg; Playwright Chromium; independent per-side copied databases/metadata and separately generated seeded two-part audio files.

verification.codecPolicyRegressionTest: red before implementation (undefined transcodeAudioCodec), green after implementation

limitations: Four WebP cover-resize API requests return matching 500 responses because the host FFmpeg lacks a WebP encoder; these remain explicit shared failures, not successful cover behavior.
Media-time advancement is verified in F09. Durable periodic progress synchronization is separately assigned to F12; the client source first syncs at 20 seconds.
Only this forced-transcode AAC copy path is compared. Other force-AAC codecs, reset/seek races, shutdown during reset, and broader playback variants remain open.
